description: Positive and negative conformance vectors for the MCP++ A2A execution extension schemas. Well-formed declarations and terminal evidence must validate. Malformed extension URIs/fields and unsupported profiles are expected failures (fail closed).

well_formed.description: Well-formed extension declaration, activation, metadata, and terminal evidence.

malformed.description: Malformed extension URI, missing required fields, forged markers, and non-portable terminal claims. Expected failures.

unsupported_profile.description: Unknown profile letters and profile claims outside the agent advertisement. Expected failures.

error_codes.A2A_MALFORMED_EXTENSION_URI: uri is reverse-DNS-only, non-HTTPS, wrong host, or otherwise not the confirmed wire URI when claiming MCP++ execution
error_codes.A2A_MALFORMED_EXTENSION: AgentExtension / params / activation / metadata fails structural schema validation
error_codes.A2A_MISSING_RECEIPT_CID: portable completed terminal evidence lacks receipt_cid
error_codes.A2A_UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE: requested profile letter is unknown or not advertised by the agent
error_codes.A2A_PROFILE_NOT_SUBSET: requested_profiles is not a subset of advertised_profiles
